review_notices: Original static DoomCube 350 CAD reference. Motion preview is disabled until cable, belt, chain and mounting registrations have native evidence.
Exactly one source frame and the original stock Doom gantry are visible. Alternate gantries and other skirt styles are retained in the private native intake, not mixed into this assembly.

Three original baseline printed bodies have self-intersecting native wires. Their finite original tessellations are retained unmodified for visual reference; these bodies and their mounting are not native-solid qualified.
The repository describes this source as complete-ish. Source omissions and unqualified native interfaces remain open findings.
No built-in supports have been removed: no separate support leaf was positively identified. This is not a certificate that all source printed bodies are free of embedded supports.

The native 6 mm stock gantry uses its MGN9 X rail/block and standard probe bracket; imported MGN12 and 9 mm alternatives are inactive. This selection does not qualify the invalid original printed carriage interfaces.
